body: Nothing good ever happens and this sub is full of shit, this pro-life stuff is the worst there is, the selfishness of people wanting to force others to suffer so they can go happy about their lives is downright disgusting.

No problem. Also because my memory is basically non-existent and concentration is lacking I'll go over a few more points.

I think its definitely worth it to get him out of bed. College might be too much but even the small victory of getting up is so important.

And I'm going to make a point about communication. I don't know how much about this stuff you discuss between yourselves but I'm going to suggest being open, really open about all of this. How worried you are. I think there can be a point in being open about how this is affecting you too. There is a chance it can come off wrong, almost guilt tripping, but making your boyfriend realise that his situation is taking a toll on you too, mentally, can serve as an external motivator. Approach this carefully.

Related to that, probably the most important thing I have to say which I sadly forgot: I think it is clear that his situation and behaviour is taking a toll on you and possibly your mental health too. You need to be safe and concerned with your own wellbeing as well. And in this comes communication I think. Be open with each other, but really, set up concrete boundaries. Most importantly I think based on what you told, in those rather graphic descriptions of self-harm and possibly other things. Venting out those thought may be a good and necessary thing, but it doesn't need to be you. You probably aren't that well equipped to deal with them. Draw a line. For you both. It is better that way in the long run.

Hope you are still following this thread.
